m4sub.k_star.spec: decision_breakdown()'s k* for the pooled champion (submission-118) against all 60 rival submissions, on the real per-series MASE matrix -- the fewest series whose removal unseats the champion. `frac` is k*/T with T = series here, not years as on the time-series panels S2 reports k* on elsewhere

m4sub.winner_stability.spec: winner_stability on the real M4 panel (61 submissions x 100000 series), block=1 (i.i.d. resampling over series: the M4 series are a cross-section with no temporal adjacency, so a block bootstrap has nothing to preserve), n_boot=2000. Descriptive only: no calibrated null is computed at this (K, T)
